description: Owned by ICDEV[OS] (osx-cop-07); exported by ICDEV[IT] (icx-cop-01, tools/idp/cop_xapi_export.py --published) beside the icos-cop-academy/v1 batch it publishes, because the batch schema admits no extra field. A person who did not prepare the batch took ICDEV[IT]'s declared step decl-wft-cop-academy-xapi-publish, bound to the batch's content_digest. ICDEV[OS] refuses a batch with no publication, a publication at another digest, and one signed by the batch's preparer.

content_digest.description: the content_digest of the batch it publishes; it must equal the batch's (recomputed)
content_digest.title: Content Digest

event_id.description: the published event in ICDEV[IT]'s cop_academy_events
event_id.title: Event Id

prepared_by.description: who prepared the batch (a person's account id, or agent:<name>)
prepared_by.title: Prepared By

role.description: that person's role when they took it
role.title: Role

row_hash.description: that event's hash on ICDEV[IT]'s hash chain (carried; ICOS cannot read that ledger)
row_hash.title: Row Hash

signed_by.description: the person who took the publish step (an ICDEV[IT] account id), never the batch's preparer
signed_by.title: Signed By

step_id.description: the declared step in ICDEV[IT]'s wf_decision_steps
step_id.title: Step Id

title: Publication
